name: neuropulse-focus
description: NeuroPulse — 轻量级反应力与专注力训练桌面小游戏 (React + TailwindCSS + Three.js + Electron + Python + SQLite)
author: NeuroPulse Studio

scripts.build: pnpm run build:frontend && pnpm run build:electron
scripts.pack:mac: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:backend && electron-builder --mac --dir --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:backend && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.dist:win: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:backend && electron-builder --win --publish never
